place.raw: Cape May, Cape May, New Jersey, USA

notes: CANONICAL (research 2026-07-04): this copy of Jonathan Pine — though unsourced in this tree — is the one that actually continues the direct line. His son Jonathan Pine (I182620314823, b.1687, Cape May, NJ) is attached here, and that descent has already been traced down through Benjamin C Pine (I182541957605) and John Pine (I182541932596) to Ann Pine (m. John Albertson, gen 6 — the already-resolved John Albertson/Ann Pine duplicate-couple, see direct-line-issues.md) and on to the documented Albertson spine.

Independently confirmed via WikiTree (Pine-62) and Geni: son of Capt. James Pine/Pyne (I182625984824, immigrant) and Susan Armitage (I182625984903); made Constable of Cape May by the NJ legislature 25 Nov 1685; moved from Hempstead to Cape May and sold his inherited Hempstead lands there 1690-2; died 17 Dec 1694 Cape May, age ~33. WikiTree also gives a wife, Abigail Carman (m. abt 1685) — a new finding not currently in this tree, not added as a record here.

DUPLICATE: I182625984979 — same vitals, sourced to Geneanet S508118847, carries both parents but no children and does not connect to the line-continuing son. See docs/research/ancestors/gen10-jonathan-pine.md.
